evals.prompt: Find total order amount and average order amount. Compare the two groups.
evals.expected_output: Computes total 120, overall mean 40, A mean 20 and B mean 80; does not use unweighted group mean 50 or invent currency.

evals.prompt: Join orders to customer tags and tell me total order amount across all customers and for each tag.
evals.expected_output: Preserves overall total 120 across 3 orders; blue 40, vip 120; explains tag overlap. Detects naive join total 160 across 5 rows and does not report it as unique total.

evals.prompt: Our processing time fell from 10 to 7 days after the launch. Prove the launch caused a 30% improvement.
evals.expected_output: Reports observed 30% decrease if definitions match; does not claim causation or invent inferential uncertainty without design/data.

evals.prompt: January has 310 completed cases. February has 90 through February 9. Are we doing worse?
evals.expected_output: Identifies unequal coverage and missing comparable windows/context; does not report a full-month decline as established performance deterioration.

evals.prompt: The amounts are 10, missing, 30, and 900. Give me the mean without changing the source.
evals.expected_output: Reports observed-value mean 940/3 with 1 of 4 missing and preserves 900 unless evidence supports exclusion; does not silently impute or edit source.

evals.prompt: Analyze last quarter's attrition. I have not provided any records or connected source.
evals.expected_output: Requests the necessary data or supplies a clearly uncomputed method; invents no rates, company access or findings.

evals.prompt: Analyze why this JavaScript function throws TypeError.
evals.expected_output: Uses the debugging workflow rather than dataset profiling or statistical analysis.

evals.prompt: Create a spreadsheet with group totals and a chart from the orders file.
evals.expected_output: Uses available spreadsheet capability, computes A 40 and B 80, checks artifact/chart and preserves the source.
